rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a shrub or bush as a plant.

example.english: That bush in the garden needs trimming.
example.traditional: 花園嗰棵灌木要修剪吓。
example.jyutping: faa1 jyun4 go2 fo2 gun3 muk6 jiu3 sau1 zin2 haa5

rows.note: Use this direct anatomical term when “bush” refers to a person’s pubic hair.

example.english: They said their bush was too thick.
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 di1 jam1 mou4 taai3 do1

rows.note: Use this for undeveloped scrubby land, especially when the setting matters more than the vegetation itself.

example.english: The bush behind the village is always full of weeds.
example.traditional: 村後面嗰幅荒地成日有野草生出嚟。
example.jyutping: cyun1 hau6 min6 go2 fuk1 fong1 dei6 seng4 jat6 jau5 je5 cou2 saang1 ceot1 lei4
